skill.name: docx
skill.description: Create, edit, inspect, and validate DOCX files with tracked changes, comments, formatting preservation, OOXML access, text extraction, and rendering workflows.
skill.summary: Create and revise DOCX files with comments, tracked changes, validation, and formatting control.
skill.author: Azeem-2

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are false positives from OOXML namespaces, compact XML templates, Markdown code formatting, and expected document tooling. Confirmed issues include unvalidated archive extraction, unhardened XML parsing, and relationship targets that can escape the document root. The analyzer reports 50 capped matches outside the provided catalog, so publication should wait for hardening and manual review. Static review was capped at 400/450 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 50 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Office archives are extracted without validating members.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths, parent traversal, and links before extraction. Enforce entry count and expanded-size limits in an isolated temporary directory.

remediation.issue: Validators use default lxml parsers for document XML.
remediation.suggestion: Use defusedxml or XMLParser with resolve_entities disabled, DTD loading disabled, and network access disabled for every untrusted XML parse.

remediation.issue: Relationship targets are resolved without document-root confinement.
remediation.suggestion: Reject resolved targets outside the unpacked root and honor TargetMode for external relationships before checking target existence.

semantic_findings.description: Validators parse document XML with default lxml parsers without disabling DTD loading and external entity resolution. A crafted XML part may access local resources on affected lxml versions.

content.user_title: Create and Edit Professional Word Documents
content.value_statement: Office teams often lose formatting and revision history when automating Word documents. This skill creates and edits DOCX files while preserving structure, comments, and tracked changes.
actual_capabilities: Extracts DOCX text to Markdown with options for accepting, rejecting, or displaying tracked changes.
Creates Word documents with styles, lists, tables, links, images, headers, footers, and page controls.
Unpacks, edits, repackages, and validates Office Open XML document structures.
Applies precise tracked insertions and deletions while preserving unchanged runs and formatting.
Adds comments, comment replies, author metadata, and required OOXML relationships.
Converts DOCX files to PDF and page images for visual inspection.
limitations: Requires external tools and libraries, including Pandoc, docx, LibreOffice, Poppler, defusedxml, and lxml.
Direct OOXML edits require careful node selection because malformed XML can corrupt a document.
Validation cannot guarantee identical rendering across Microsoft Word, LibreOffice, and other viewers.
The workflows target OOXML documents and do not directly edit legacy DOC files.

use_cases.title: Prepare Business Documents
use_cases.description: Create polished reports, proposals, and policies with consistent styles, tables, images, headers, and page layout.

use_cases.title: Review Contracts with Redlines
use_cases.description: Apply precise tracked changes and comments while preserving the original wording, formatting, and revision history.

use_cases.title: Automate Document Production
use_cases.description: Generate, inspect, validate, and render DOCX files as part of repeatable content workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DOCX named [filename]. Include a title, introduction, three sections, and a conclusion using professional Word styles.

prompt_templates.title: Revise an Existing Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [document path] to improve clarity and consistency. Preserve the layout and return the revised DOCX with a concise change summary.

prompt_templates.title: Add Tracked Review Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [document path] for [review goal]. Apply every substantive edit as a precise tracked change and add comments where decisions need confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Perform an OOXML-Preserving Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Update [document path] according to [requirements]. Preserve styles, relationships, comments, and existing revisions. Validate the OOXML and visually inspect the final pages.

output_examples.input: Create a two-page project status report with milestones, risks, and next steps.
output_examples.output: A formatted DOCX with a title, status summary, milestone table, risk section, and next-step list.

output_examples.input: Change the notice period from 30 days to 60 days and explain the revision.
output_examples.output: A revised DOCX showing only the number replacement as a tracked change, with a comment explaining the requested update.

output_examples.input: Inspect this document for broken relationships and validate its Word XML.
output: A validation result covering XML structure, relationships, content types, and tracked changes.
A corrected DOCX when the identified issues can be repaired safely.

best_practices: Work on a copy and keep the original document available for comparison.
Use minimal tracked changes so reviewers can distinguish edits from unchanged text.
Validate the OOXML and inspect rendered pages before delivering the final document.
anti_patterns: Do not replace entire paragraphs when only a word or number changes.
Do not rely on Markdown line numbers to locate content in OOXML.
Do not skip validation for production documents or assume successful packaging guarantees correct rendering.

faq.question: Can this skill create a DOCX from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses the docx JavaScript library for styled text, lists, tables, links, images, headers, footers, and page layout.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing Word document?
faq.answer: Yes. It can unpack OOXML, modify selected content, preserve formatting, validate changes, and repackage the document.

faq.question: Does it support tracked changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can add precise insertions and deletions, preserve existing revisions, and validate redlined text against the original.

faq.question: Can it add comments and replies?
faq.answer: Yes. It manages comment text, replies, authors, identifiers, content types, and the relationships required by Word.

faq.question: Which dependencies are required?
faq.answer: Tasks may require Pandoc, Node.js docx, LibreOffice, Poppler, defusedxml, lxml, Python, and Git.

faq.question: Can it process untrusted DOCX files safely?
faq.answer: Use an isolated workspace. Archive extraction, relationship validation, and XML parsing require additional hardening before processing untrusted documents.
